d: On 9 November 2026, Japan signed a security assistance agreement worth 4.3 billion yen—approximately 27 million US dollars—with the Philippines. It will provide a coastal surveillance radar for the Philippine Navy and surveillance drones for its air force. What makes this agreement new is that it is the first transfer of equipment formally classified as defence equipment through Japan’s Official Security Assistance programme.
